newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures untraded in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures untraded in slow trade.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded by midday on Friday in lethargic trade with the market looking for leads in the afternoon session, dealers said.
"It was the same old song, the market was untraded this morning. It was very flat, but the mood may change this afternoon like it did yesterday," a trader said.

The local exchange perked up after a dull morning session on Thursday when covering emerged for prompt shipments of RSS3 rubber and a total of 7,230 tonnes were traded. Deals for the other rubber brands, however, were meagre.
"The market may see some more covering later today. There was nothing to do this morning," another trader said.
At around 0445 GMT, April RSS3 was indicated at 121.50 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 121.75 cents.
April RSS1 was indicated at 172.00-174.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21-$1.22) a kg from the previous 173.00 cents.
April TSR20 was indicated at 168.50-170.50 Singapore cents (US$1.18-$1.20) a kg from the previous 169.50 cents.
